personas.name: Emily Johnson
personas.pain_point: Struggles to find available vets nearby on short notice, causing stress during pet emergencies.

personas.pain_point: Has difficulty managing appointment slots and communicating real-time availability to potential clients.

features.name: Vet Search by Location
features.description: Allows users to find veterinary clinics nearby by leveraging GPS and location filters such as distance and specialty.

features.name: Real-Time Availability Updates
features.description: Displays real-time appointment availability from vets’ calendars, updating dynamically to show open slots or busy times.

features.name: Booking Functionality

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Stores pet information, past appointments, and user preferences to streamline future bookings and personalized recommendations.

features.name: Vet Clinic Profiles with Reviews and Ratings

payload.html:
Find, Book, and Get Real-Time Availability Updates for Nearby Veterinarians

A mobile app designed to help dog owners quickly locate and book vets with live appointment updates — no stress, just care.

Get Early Access

Features

  • Vet Search by Location

    Allows users to find veterinary clinics nearby by leveraging GPS and location filters such as distance and specialty.

  • Real-Time Availability Updates

    Displays real-time appointment availability from vets’ calendars, updating dynamically to show open slots or busy times.

  • Booking Functionality

    Enables users to book appointments directly within the app with confirmation notifications and calendar integration.

  • User Profiles

    Stores pet information, past appointments, and user preferences to streamline future bookings and personalized recommendations.

  • Vet Clinic Profiles with Reviews and Ratings

    Provides detailed information about each vet clinic including services offered, user reviews, photos, and ratings to help user decision-making.

VetFinder

email.body:
Hi,

Struggling to find an available vet nearby when your dog needs care urgently? Our mobile app makes it easy to locate veterinary clinics near you using GPS-based location filters and specialty options. You'll see real-time appointment availability from vets’ calendars, so you can quickly identify open slots.

Book appointments directly in the app and get immediate confirmations with calendar integration to keep track. Say goodbye to the hassle of waiting on hold or calling multiple clinics. 

Start booking your pet’s vet visit now or learn more about how it works.

Best regards,
LaunchMind Team
